name: Getting Into Heaven
overview: Scripture teaches that entrance into heaven is not guaranteed by mere profession of faith but requires doing the will of the Father, as Jesus emphasizes in Matthew 7:21. The path to eternal life is narrow and demands careful obedience, contrasting with the broad way leading to destruction (Matthew 7:13). Jesus fulfilled the law and prophets, underscoring the importance of genuine righteousness rather than outward show (Matthew 5:17; 6:1). Forgiveness of others is also essential, reflecting the heart of the heavenly Father who forgives us (Matthew 6:14). Ultimately, seeking eternal life involves sincere pursuit of God's will rather than reliance on self-righteous deeds (Matthew 19:16).
